text:
Maya T.: Heads-up: marketing wants to blast the release post for the new batching + prefix caching tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final changelog blurb, docs URL, and the exact rollout windows from eng.
Diego S.: Changelog draft is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/449 — includes API rename (batching.strategy), perf delta table, and migration note. Can finalize once QA signs off.
Priya N.: Docs draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/230 — added examples and a migration checklist. Waiting on the exact param name to adjust code samples.
Maya T.: Also need a 1-line bench takeaway for the blog header and a short tweetable stat. Keep it punchy.
Diego S.: Bench headline: "~25% lower token costs and ~40ms p95 improvement on 4k chat workloads." Raw numbers in PR.
Priya N.: Webinar? We can do a short demo noon PT—20m demo + 20m Q&A. Marketing to provide registration link.
Maya T.: Prefer the webinar 11:00 PT to catch EMEA. Please confirm.
Priya N.: 11:00 PT works. I'll prep a demo script focusing on migration and observability dashboards.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start 2026-03-25T10:00:00-07:00 (5% -> 25% -> 100% over 6 hours). Monitor: https://deploys.redwood.ai/1289
Diego S.: Rollout policy: canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 2h, then 100% if metrics stable. Regions: US/EU first, APAC next-day low-traffic window. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate >0.6% or p95 increase >30%.
docs-bot: Docs site updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/batching — migration note added for batching.strategy alias.
Maya T.: Final checklist: (1) changelog merged, (2) docs merged, (3) deploy scheduled, (4) bench blurb approved, (5) webinar page live. Reply with :white_check_mark: once your item is done.
Diego S.: changelog merged :white_check_mark:
Priya N.: docs merged :white_check_mark:
Maya T.: Webinar link received from events team and added to blog draft. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Canary started 2026-03-25T10:00:00-07:00 — monitoring dashboards: https://observability.redwood.ai/d/rollout/1289
Maya T.: Publishing announcement at 10:05 PT (small buffer) and pushing social at 10:15 PT. Thanks everyone — short and sweet.
